figurative_meaning_en: contrary to; deviation; breach of condition
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথার খিলাফ করো না, যা বলেছ তাই করো।
চুক্তির খিলাফ কোনো কাজ করবেন না।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't go against your word; do as you said.
Do not act contrary to the agreement.
history: Borrowed from Arabic 'khilaf' meaning opposition, commonly used in Bengali to denote going against agreements or words.
note: Often used in phrases like 'কথার খিলাফ' to emphasize fidelity to promises.
